definitions.full: H5106. nu [ נוא ] verb hinder, restrain, frustrate (Arabic () (or ) rise with difficulty, rise against one (Frey), III. contend with , Lane 2861 ); — Qal Imperfect 2masculine plural תנואון Num 32:7 Kt, but read Hiph`il (so Qr), compare Di. Hiph`il Perfect הֵנִיא Num 30:6 , etc.; Imperfect יָנִיא 30:9 , יָנִי Psa 141:5 , תְּנִיאוּן Num 32:7 Qr; — 1 restrain, forbid (performance of vow), followed by accusative of person Num 30:6 (twice in verse); 30:9 ; 30:12 ; frustrate (device of people), subject ׳י , followed by accusative of thing, Psa 33:10 (|| הֵפִיר ); refuse 141:5 ((text dubious see Che). 2 restrain, make averse the heart (accusative) Num 32:7 (followed by מֵעֲבֹר ), 32:9 (followed by לְבִלְתִּיבֿאֹ ).
